New Effect: All Legendary items can now be upgraded into Masterwork items.

This excludes Mejai's Soulstealer and Legendary items that can be upgraded such as all Support items, Vigilant Wardstone , and all Tear of the Goddess upgrades ( Archangel's Staff , Manamune , Winter's Approach ).
Upon an item being upgraded into its Masterwork variant, it gains the ( Masterwork ) descriptor and has certain innate stats increased based on a table of values.

Statistics' gold value is represented by the following table, which also lists the ones which can be upgraded. This table also formally represents Riot's official stance on each statistic's gold efficiency, although not all stat types are included for the purposes of Masterwork items.
31.25 /1 ability haste (explicit)
20 /1 ability power ( Amplifying Tome 400 ÷ 20 ability power )
35 /1 attack damage ( Long Sword 350 ÷ 10 attack damage )
30 /1% attack speed ( Dagger 300 ÷ 10% attack speed )
20 /1 armor ( Cloth Armor 300 ÷ 15 armor )
18 /1 magic resistance ( Null-Magic Mantle 450 ÷ 25 magic resistance )

Variable gold /1 health , based on how many upgradeable stats exist on the item: If the item has health only, health on that item is valued at 2.6 per point ( Ruby Crystal 400 ÷ 150 health ). If the item has health and only one other upgradeable stat, health on that item is valued at 2.702 per point. If the item has health and two other upgradeable stats, health on that item is valued at 2.6 per point ( Ruby Crystal 400 ÷ 150 health ). If the item has health and three other (or more) upgradeable stats, health on that item is valued at 2.7 per point.
If the item has health only, health on that item is valued at 2.6 per point ( Ruby Crystal 400 ÷ 150 health ).

While not currently possible, if an item has no upgradeable stats, 1000 worth of health will be added to the item. [ 1 ]

The total gold value of all increased stats remains at 1000 . However, old Masterwork items only considered this value a general guideline (for the sake of cleaner numbers on the increased stats); the new upgraded items' value increases by precisely 1000 as a strict rule (according to the above table).

All stats that are increased share equal gold value. For example, if an item has attack damage and attack speed , each upgraded stat will increase by 500 gold of value; if an item has ability haste , armor , and magic resistance , each upgraded stat will increase by 333.3 gold of value; etc.
Note that the values are rounded down in item tooltips, but are granted as normal.
